Name: Interactive Community Centre
Author: seifkingSK
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/qcl7fhL.png[/img]
[url=https://www.stardewvalley.net/][img]https://i.imgur.com/2mqL6Uu.png[/img][/url] [url=https://smapi.io/][img]https://i.imgur.com/z1YXh1a.png[/img][/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54492][img]https://i.imgur.com/pu4KdGu.png[/img][/url] [img]https://i.imgur.com/KqHkrSg.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/dLkzl2p.png[/img] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4525][img]https://i.imgur.com/KPRFgYP.png[/img][/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][img]https://i.imgur.com/cNhm40R.png[/img][/url] [img]https://i.imgur.com/Q0tj0B7.png[/img][/center]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UINQfef.png[/img]
[left][size=4]In the base game, once the last bundle is done, the restored Community Centre has little left to do inside. This mod gives the finished building things to do: the Bulletin Board, the Boiler Room, the kitchen corner's stove and fridge, and the props in the Pantry, Crafts Room and Vault.[/size]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/TVLxM2L.png[/img][/center]
[size=4][i]- [b]Orders Board[/b]: the Bulletin Board becomes a Special Orders board. It opens a few days after the whole Community Centre is restored (Lewis sends a letter) and refreshes every Monday, like the town board. Ships with [b]64 orders[/b] from 35 villagers (Vanilla only for now).[/i][/size]
[spoiler]
[center][size=4][i][img]https://i.imgur.com/OxjLGwc.gif[/img]
Pick an order from the board; it goes straight to your journal.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tEwOLPI.gif[/img]
Deliver it, then collect the reward from your journal[/i][/size][/center]
[/spoiler]
[size=4][i]- [b]Prize Tickets[/b]: every finished order also earns a Prize Ticket, collected from a ticket box beside the bulletin board, like the one next to the town board. Can be turned off in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][color=#e69138]GMCM[/color][/url].
- [b]Clint's anvil in the Boiler Room[/b]: the furnace makes way for Clint's anvil and a water trough. While Clint is in the Boiler Room (his Friday visit, or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][color=#e69138]SVE[/color][/url]'s Community Day), the anvil opens his tool-upgrade shop and hands back your finished upgrades.[/i][/size]
[spoiler][center][size=4][i][img]https://i.imgur.com/ZNOUv2f.gif[/img]
Clint's upgrade shop, right at the anvil.[/i][/size][/center]
[/spoiler]
[size=4][i]- [b]Community Centre kitchen[/b]: the stove cooks and the fridge stores, like your farmhouse kitchen. The kitchen corner is part of the Pantry, or its own room with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54473][color=#e69138]Junimo Bundles Plus[/color][/url]'s Kitchen room.[/i][/size]
[spoiler][center][size=4][i][img]https://i.imgur.com/eB57DlM.gif[/img]
The fridge stores, the stove cooks.[/i][/size][/center]
[/spoiler]
[size=4][i]- [b]Room props[/b] (Junimo route): the globe and map table open the map; the dye pot and sewing machine work after Emily's sewing event; and, where the map has them, the telephones, a radio that works like a TV, a shared chest for the whole farm and a crafting table that crafts from it. Works with the vanilla, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][color=#e69138]SVE[/color][/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6966][color=#e69138]Community Center Reimagined[/color][/url] ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657][color=#e69138]LemurKat[/color][/url]) maps.[/i][/size]
[spoiler][center][size=4][i][img]https://i.imgur.com/xhD0ayJ.gif[/img]
The globe, a telephone and the radio.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/O5BVM8k.gif[/img]
The crafting table uses the shared (now usable) chest.[/i][/size][/center]
[/spoiler]
[size=4][i]- [b]Spinning wheel, preserves jars and pantry shelves[/b]: the spinning wheel works as a loom, and the two preserves jars (SVE map) work like your own. The Pantry's jar shelf and crates give a few items once a day; the crates do the same but follow the current season.[/i][/size]
[spoiler][center][size=4][i][img]https://i.imgur.com/DK7oT3Q.gif[/img]
The spinning wheel and a preserves jar at work.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UtmPDUH.gif[/img]
A morning's pantry loot: the jar shelf, then a crate.[/i][/size][/center]
[/spoiler]
[size=4][i]- [b]Crop plot[/b] ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][color=#e69138]Stardew Valley Expanded[/color][/url]): the painted garden in the main hall becomes real soil. You plant the front half; the villagers farm the back half, planting, watering and harvesting it themselves, any season. With the crop plot turned off, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55403][color=#e69138]Living Fields[/color][/url], if installed, has the villagers farm the whole garden instead.[/i][/size]
[spoiler][center][size=4][i][img]https://i.imgur.com/Vq4QCM2.gif[/img]
Your half and the villagers' half, day by day.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ILSddBf.gif[/img]
The villagers' half is theirs, players cannot interact with them.[/i][/size][/center]
[/spoiler]
[size=4][i]- [b]Vault bank[/b]: the vault safe holds a bank account for each player. Deposit for interest, savings or challenges, or borrow against your skills, farm buildings and tools.[/i][/size]
[spoiler][center][size=4][i][img]https://i.imgur.com/yoeci50.gif[/img]
Deposit, borrow and repay at the vault safe.[/i][/size][/center]
[/spoiler]
[size=4][i]- Every room and prop can be turned off in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][color=#e69138]GMCM[/color][/url].
- [b]Works with[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115][color=#e69138]Better Crafting[/color][/url] (the crafting table opens it, with the shared chest)[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115][/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]Love of Cooking[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21286][color=#e69138]Informant[/color][/url] (crop tooltips on the plot).
- [b]Content-pack extensible[/b]: add your own orders, requesters, drop boxes and pantry loot from your own mod folder, no coding needed.[/i][/size][/left]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Uohxu8h.png[/img]
[center][size=4][b][color=#e69138]1.[/color][/b] Download and install [url=https://smapi.io/][color=#e69138]SMAPI[/color][/url].
[b][color=#e69138]2.[/color][/b] Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54492][color=#e69138]SK's Core Engine[/color][/url] (required).
[b][color=#e69138]3.[/color][/b] (Optional) Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][color=#e69138]GMCM[/color][/url] for the in-game settings menu.
[b][color=#e69138]4.[/color][/b] Download this mod and drop it in your [color=#f4f4f4]Mods[/color] folder.
[b][color=#e69138]5.[/color][/b] Play! Works on new and existing saves: everything unlocks once the Community Centre is fully restored.[/size][/center]

[quote][i]Want to write your own orders? Write an [color=#f4f4f4]orders.json[/color] in your own mod folder, no coding needed. Full authoring guide: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4525]Orders Board Authoring[/url] article. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/55152][color=#e69138]SK's Core Editor[/color][/url] (optional) has an in-game Orders Board screen that writes it for you.
Your own drop boxes: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4553]Drop Boxes Authoring[/url]. Your own pantry loot: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4554]Pantry Loot Authoring[/url]. The editor has a screen for each.[/i][/quote]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PoPsPXp.png[/img]
[center][size=4]Text is in English for now, and translations from native speakers are welcome. The mod's [color=#f4f4f4]i18n[/color] folder already has a file for every language the game supports ([color=#f4f4f4]de, es, fr, hu, it, ja, ko, pt, ru, tr, zh[/color]), filled with the English text. Translate the lines in your language's file and send it in a post or private message here: I'll add it in the next update and credit you.[/size][/center]
[center][size=4][i]- No translations yet: every language is open.[/i][/size][/center]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qXg7DRQ.png[/img]
[left][b]Does it work on my current save?[/b]
Yes. Nothing is baked in at save creation: each feature unlocks the day it finds the Community Centre fully restored.

[b]Does it work with a vanilla Community Centre?[/b]
Yes. With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54473][color=#e69138]Junimo Bundles Plus[/color][/url]'s Kitchen room, everything unlocks once all seven rooms are restored.

[b]Does it work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657][color=#e69138]LemurKat[/color][/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6966][color=#e69138]Community Center Reimagined[/color][/url]?[/b]
Yes. Where the full smithy doesn't fit, the anvil goes on its own, and if no spot fits at all, the boiler is used to open Clint's shop instead. The room props work there too.

[b]Does it work on the Joja route?[/b]
No. On the Joja route the Community Centre becomes a Joja warehouse, so there's nothing for this mod to open.

[b]Can I turn off single orders?[/b]
Yes: the [b]Built-in orders[/b] page in the mod's settings ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][color=#e69138]GMCM[/color][/url], title screen) lists every order that comes with the mod by requester. A turned-off order is never offered; one you already accepted still finishes.

[b]Does it work in multiplayer?[/b]
Yes. The host sets the Orders Board's unlock day and which built-in orders are turned off, and every farmhand gets both. The Community Centre fridge is a normal chest, so it syncs and locks like any other. Each player has their own vault account (one shared account if the farm shares its money); the pantry loot, the shared chest and the crop plot are the whole farm's. [i](Tested only on local Co-op)[/i]

[b]Is it safe to uninstall?[/b]
Yes, after one console command. As the host, with no farmhands connected, type [b]icc_prepare_uninstall[/b] in the SMAPI console, then save. It:
- removes the crop plot's soil and crops,
- moves everything in the fridge, the shared chest, the spinning wheel and the preserves jars to the Lost and Found,
- closes every vault account (savings are paid out, debts are collected),
- removes the Orders Board's orders and moves unclaimed Prize Tickets to the prize box in town.
The mod then stays off until you restart the game. The board, the Boiler Room and the stove go back to how the game has them.

[/left]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/efem2sa.png[/img]
[center][size=4][i]- Junimo route only: on the Joja route the building is a warehouse.
- The sewing machine, telephones, shared chest, crafting table and preserves jars are only where the map has them, and the crop plot needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][color=#e69138]SVE[/color][/url]'s map.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][color=#e69138]Stardew Valley Expanded[/color][/url] shows its Community Centre only to players who saw the completion ceremony. A farmhand who joins afterwards sees the vanilla building, so the room props and the garden plot don't line up for them. Fix: type [b]icc_see_cc_ceremony[/b] in the SMAPI console (it marks the ceremony as seen for every player on that computer, split-screen included), then sleep.[/i][/size][/center]

Manifest.Name: SK's Interactive Community Centre
Manifest.Description: Adds living-in features to the completed Community Center: Clint's upgrade shop on the Boiler Room furnace, a villager request board, and a cooking station.
